summary: Frontend testing of Brand Onboarding Pipeline and Agreement Management features - All major features PASS. Pipeline shows 7 Kanban stages with expandable sub-stages, brand cards display correctly with commission/status badges, clicking brand cards navigates to detail page with full Agreement & Onboarding section.

issues: BUYING & SOURCING breadcrumb text in page header shows as 'Buying & Sourcing' (sentence case) not 'BUYING & SOURCING' (uppercase) as per test expectations - minor styling inconsistency

seed_data_creation: None - used existing brand data (Nappa Dori in Agreement Signed stage)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Brand Onboarding Pipeline fully functional at /sourcing/brands/onboarding. All 7 stages (New Lead, Contacted, Negotiating, Agreement Sent, Agreement Signed, Onboarding, Active Partner) with expandable sub-stages working. Brand cards show name, city, segment, commission badge, agreement status, days-in-stage indicator. Stage navigation arrows (<>) on cards work. Brand Detail page has 'Agreement & Onboarding' section with Commission Rate, Payment Terms, Contract Dates, Special Terms fields displayed in view mode. Edit mode is accessed via separate /edit route for brand information only (not inline agreement editing).
